name: Ledger Nano Gen5 case
description: Replacement case for a bare Ledger Nano Gen5 board: a tray that holds the board with its touchscreen and battery, with openings for the USB-C port and the side button. This version has the tray only; the top bezel that snaps onto it follows. Print the tray floor-down in PLA at 100% scale with a 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers and supports off. The board dimensions are placeholders and the fit has not been tested yet: measure the board and adjust the parameters in generate.py before printing.
